name: Checkers (Draughts) Pieces

king.description: Crowned piece, double-stacked disc with crown glyph

note: Standard checkers set: 12 pieces per player. Men move forward diagonally; kings move diagonally in any direction. Pieces promote to kings (crowned, shown as stacked discs) upon reaching the opponent's back rank. Common color pairs: red/black (American), white/black (international).
